    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.drugname = 'clonidine HCl 0.1 mg PO tabs' THEN 1 END) AS clonidine_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.diagnosisname LIKE '%s/p breast biopsy%' THEN 1 END) AS biopsy_count,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.drugname = 'clonidine HCl 0.1 mg PO tabs' THEN 1 END) > 0
             AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.diagnosisname LIKE '%s/p breast biopsy%' THEN 1 END) > 0
        THEN 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.drugname = 'clonidine HCl 0.1 mg PO tabs' THEN 1 END), 0)

    END AS survival_probability

LEFT JOIN treatment m ON p.patientunitstayid = m.patientunitstayid
WHERE d.diagnosisname LIKE '%s/p breast biopsy%'
GROUP BY p.uniquepid
